verification.details: A Jizhi platform agent (scene 7953) is bridged to τ-bench over the Channel V2 WebSocket and wrapped as a `HalfDuplexAgent`. Each turn the 7953 agent emits a pure JSON object (`{"tool_calls": [...]}` or `{"message": "..."}`); the adapter executes the τ-bench tools locally and feeds the results back. A `CONTRACT` instruction block is injected ahead of the domain policy in the agent's system prompt

model_release.announcement_title: DeepSeek-V4-Pro official version has been launched
